entries.title: Person found dead in garbage container in Austin
entries.summary: <p>A person was found dead in a garbage container Saturday afternoon in Austin.</p><p>The person, a male whose age wasn’t known, was found unresponsive about 1:30 p.m. in the 4700 block of West Arthington Street, Chicago police said.</p><p>He was pronounced dead at the scene, police said.</p><p>No other information was available. Detectives are conducting a death investigation.</p>
entries.author: Sun-Times Wire

entries.title: Man shot, killed in South Chicago
entries.summary: <p>A man was found fatally shot Saturday in South Chicago.</p><p>The man, age unknown, was discovered about 11:45 a.m. in the 8000 block of South Marquette Avenue with gunshot wounds to the side and chest, Chicago police said.</p><p>He was taken to University of Chicago Medical Center, where he was pronounced dead, police said.</p><p>No arrests were reported.</p>
entries.author: Sun-Times Wire
